events.title: Fastolf's convoy beats off the French at the Battle of the Herrings
events.description: Near Rouvray, north of Orléans, French and Scottish forces under Charles of Bourbon and Sir John Stewart of Darnley attacked a supply convoy bound for the English army besieging the city. Its escort under Sir John Fastolf won decisively.
events.html: Near Rouvray, north of Orléans, French and Scottish forces under Charles of Bourbon and Sir John Stewart of Darnley attacked a supply convoy bound for the English army besieging the city. Its escort under Sir John Fastolf won decisively.

events.title: Castile orders its Muslims to convert or leave
events.description: A decree of Isabella I gave the Muslims of Castile a choice between baptism and exile. Most converted, becoming Moriscos, whose descendants were expelled from Spain in 1609-14.
events.html: A decree of Isabella I gave the Muslims of Castile a choice between baptism and exile. Most converted, becoming Moriscos, whose descendants were expelled from Spain in 1609-14.

events.title: Pedro de Valdivia founds Santiago in Chile
events.description: The Spanish conquistador Pedro de Valdivia founded Santiago in the central valley at the foot of the Andes. It became the seat of the governors of Chile and, from 1609, of its royal audiencia.
events.html: The Spanish conquistador Pedro de Valdivia founded Santiago in the central valley at the foot of the Andes. It became the seat of the governors of Chile and, from 1609, of its royal audiencia.

events.title: Lady Jane Grey is executed at the Tower
events.description: The teenage Protestant queen, deposed after nine days in 1553, was beheaded on Mary I's orders following Wyatt's Rebellion. Her husband Guildford Dudley was executed the same morning.
events.html: The teenage Protestant queen, deposed after nine days in 1553, was beheaded on Mary I's orders following Wyatt's Rebellion. Her husband Guildford Dudley was executed the same morning.

events.title: Abraham Lincoln is born in Kentucky
events.description: Born in a one-room log cabin near Hodgenville, Lincoln was largely self-taught. As the 16th President he led the Union through the Civil War and helped bring about the end of slavery.
events.html: Born in a one-room log cabin near Hodgenville, Lincoln was largely self-taught. As the 16th President he led the Union through the Civil War and helped bring about the end of slavery.

events.title: Charles Darwin is born in Shrewsbury
events.description: Born on the same day as Lincoln, Darwin sailed on HMS Beagle and developed the theory of evolution by natural selection, published in 'On the Origin of Species' in 1859.
events.html: Born on the same day as Lincoln, Darwin sailed on HMS Beagle and developed the theory of evolution by natural selection, published in 'On the Origin of Species' in 1859.

events.title: Chile proclaims its independence from Spain
events.description: Bernardo O'Higgins formally proclaimed Chile's independence on the first anniversary of the victory at Chacabuco. Spanish forces were decisively beaten at Maipú that April.
events.html: Bernardo O'Higgins formally proclaimed Chile's independence on the first anniversary of the victory at Chacabuco. Spanish forces were decisively beaten at Maipú that April.

events.title: The Creek cede their last Georgia lands at Indian Springs
events.description: By the Treaty of Indian Springs, concluded with the United States, the Muscogee (Creek) ceded the last of their lands in Georgia to the US government and migrated west. An additional article was added to the treaty two days later.
events.html: By the Treaty of Indian Springs, concluded with the United States, the Muscogee (Creek) ceded the last of their lands in Georgia to the US government and migrated west. An additional article was added to the treaty two days later.

events.title: Puyi, the last Emperor of China, abdicates
events.description: The Empress Dowager Longyu issued the edict of abdication for the six-year-old Puyi. The fall of the Qing ended more than two thousand years of imperial rule in China.
events.html: The Empress Dowager Longyu issued the edict of abdication for the six-year-old Puyi. The fall of the Qing ended more than two thousand years of imperial rule in China.

events.title: Soviet authorities arrest Aleksandr Solzhenitsyn
events.description: Weeks after 'The Gulag Archipelago' appeared in Paris, the Nobel laureate was arrested in Moscow and charged with treason. The next day he was stripped of citizenship and deported to West Germany.

song: American folk music and the American left of the Great Depression
